title: The Behavioral Fabric of LLM-Powered GUI Agents: Human Values and Interaction Outcomes

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the price percentiles of items selected by agents in a baseline condition (without explicit value instructions) to determine if their choices disproportionately skew toward lower-priced options compared to the domain median.

Analyzing agent reasoning logs and final selections in baseline tasks to observe their reliance on social proof heuristics, such as defaulting to highly rated items or bestseller badges when explicit criteria are absent.

Measuring agent step counts and interaction trajectories across tasks to identify a tendency to prematurely terminate searches and minimize actions when encountering salient promotional UI cues like discount badges.
